title: UniGADD: Universal Generator-Agnostic Deepfake Detector
abstract: arXiv:2611.07647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we introduce Universal Generator-Agnostic Deepfake Detector (UniGADD), a novel method that employs supervised learning to achieve high accuracy on known deepfake generators, while maintaining robust performance on previously unseen ones. The proposed approach follows a two-stage optimisation process. In the first stage, a contrastive loss encourages the model to learn discriminative feature embeddings from real and known fake images, resulting in strong performance within the training domain. In the second stage, the embedding space is refined by promoting inter-cluster separation and intra-cluster compactness, applied exclusively to real samples. This refinement enhances generalisability, enabling the method to exhibit improved robustness against unseen deepfake generation techniques. translated_title: UniGADD：通用生成器无关的深度伪造检测器
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们提出了通用生成器无关的深度伪造检测器（UniGADD），这是一种新颖的方法，采用监督学习在已知的深度伪造生成器上实现高精度检测，同时对之前未见过的生成器保持稳健的性能。所提出的方法遵循两阶段优化过程：在第一阶段，对比损失促使模型从真实图像和已知伪造图像中学习判别性特征嵌入，从而在训练域内取得强劲性能；在第二阶段，通过促进簇间分离和簇内紧凑性来细化嵌入空间，且该细化过程仅应用于真实样本。这种细化增强了泛化能力，使该方法对未见过的深度伪造生成技术展现出更强的鲁棒性。UniGADD在已知生成器上的准确率与最先进方法相当，同时在未见案例上显著优于它们。
tldr: UniGADD提出了一种两阶段优化的监督学习方法，通过对比损失学习和仅针对真实样本的嵌入空间细化，实现了对已知深度伪造生成器的高精度检测，并对未知生成技术具有强泛化能力。
en_tdlr: UniGADD is a two-stage supervised learning framework that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on known deepfake generators and robust generalization to unseen ones through contrastive feature learning and real-sample-only embedding space refinement.
